title: DNA OS MCP → Owner Command Connection
scope: Only the existing MCP submit_command path into the Owner command system and its live-verified agent-host worker path.

security.rule: Secret values are never recorded. Only reference names and resolution mechanisms are recorded.

references.name: OWNER_COMMAND_HTTP_SHARED_SECRET
references.used_by: DnaOsHttpClient Authorization header and Core requireSharedSecret
references.resolution: process environment supplied to the trusted local process

references.name: DNA_OS_OWNER_SESSION_ID
references.used_by: stdio MCP owner-session pointer when no explicit caller context is bound
references.resolution: process environment; Core still validates the pointer

references.name: x-dna-os-owner-session
references.resolution: request header; value is only a pointer into the Owner Authentication store

boundaries.transport_or_signal: MCP JSON-RPC over Streamable HTTP POST /mcp, or stdio
boundaries.authentication: HTTP caller context is derived from x-dna-os-owner-session, or internal credential; stdio is unauthenticated unless a valid owner session is explicitly supplied
boundaries.authority_permission: Only OWNER_VERIFIED may discover/invoke submit_command; caller identity is not accepted from tool arguments
boundaries.input_schema: MCP tool call with commandText:string and optional agentIdentity:{id:string,email?:string}; agentIdentity is correlation-only
boundaries.output_result: MCP CallToolResult with status, correlation_id, DNA OS command/work/task identifiers, result status, output lane, evidence, error/reason
boundaries.state_transition: MCP request accepted, denied, or forwarded to the registered tool handler
failure_modes: tool not discoverable/invokable: export policy denial
stdio without a valid owner session

boundaries.transport_or_signal: Typed function call; one adapter instance
boundaries.endpoint: None; next boundary is Core HTTP
boundaries.authentication: Caller session is bound to the client from transport context; handler does not mint or accept it as authority
boundaries.authority_permission: submit_command is classified as owner-command and passes the MCP export gate first
boundaries.output_result: DnaOsHttpResponse {status, body}, surfaced without fabrication by the MCP handler
boundaries.state_transition: Tool invocation becomes a Core request with a generated correlation_id

boundaries.authentication: Authorization: Bearer resolved from OWNER_COMMAND_HTTP_SHARED_SECRET when present; x-dna-os-owner-session when bound
boundaries.authority_permission: Network shared secret authenticates the trusted transport client; it is explicitly not Owner authentication
boundaries.input_schema: {commandText:string, ownerIdentity?:{id:string,email:string}}; MCP currently sends commandText and does not use ownerIdentity as authority
boundaries.output_result: Real Core HTTP status and parsed JSON body
boundaries.state_transition: External/MCP request enters the existing Core owner-command ingress
failure_modes: 401/503 when shared-secret reference is unavailable or invalid

boundaries.transport_or_signal: x-dna-os-owner-session header, or validated stdio session pointer
boundaries.authentication: Session must exist, be active, unexpired, and authenticated_via must start with human-verification
boundaries.authority_permission: Only a valid human-verified Owner session can bind Owner authority; header value alone is not proof
boundaries.state_transition: Unauthenticated/invalid request stops before Owner command submission; valid request is bound to the authenticated owner identity

boundaries.transport_or_signal: Authenticated owner id from validated session
boundaries.authentication: Inherited from b04; no body identity can replace it
boundaries.authority_permission: Maps the authenticated human to the fixed DNA OS account/workspace scope and execution grant
boundaries.output_result: EnvelopeIdentity with identity_id=supabase-<authenticated id>, kind=human, fixed account/workspace scope
boundaries.state_transition: Authenticated session becomes an Owner command principal
failure_modes: body ownerIdentity does not match authenticated owner: OWNER_IDENTITY_MISMATCH

boundaries.transport_or_signal: In-process function call after JSON/body and auth checks
boundaries.authority_permission: submitOwnerCommand accepts only an identity whose kind is human
boundaries.output_result: SubmitOwnerCommandOutcome containing command envelope, work_id, lifecycle, result, surface, output_routing
boundaries.state_transition: command_received → classify/route → admitted or terminal result
failure_modes: Owner continuation may ask/reject rather than route a new command

boundaries.transport_or_signal: CommandEnvelope with command_id, issued_by, intent, payload, issued_at
boundaries.authentication: Owner identity remains attached to the envelope
boundaries.authority_permission: Router selects only registered capabilities; execution-policy context is required for execution.run paths
boundaries.input_schema: CommandEnvelope plus RouteOptions; executionRequestBase is optional at this boundary but required by execution.run
boundaries.output_result: CapabilityResult with task_id, capability_id, status, summary, evidence, artifacts, warnings, next_action
boundaries.state_transition: command envelope is classified, a task is created, then a capability result is admitted/terminalized
failure_modes: execution policy context missing for execution.run

boundaries.authority_permission: Registry is the source of supported capability IDs, endpoint contracts, permission requirements, and health status
boundaries.input_schema: Command text and/or structured owner context
boundaries.output_result: Exactly one matched capability, or UNSUPPORTED_COMMAND/OWNER_REVIEW
boundaries.state_transition: Raw intent becomes a selected registered capability; no match or ambiguity is terminal/blocking

boundaries.endpoint: In-process contract; worker launch is controlled by Agent Host
boundaries.authentication: Owner command/task lineage and Agent Host confinement; registry entry declares permission_requirement=none
boundaries.authority_permission: Registry entry is CONNECTED; Agent Host enforces its own sandbox-exec confinement and write gate
boundaries.input_schema: WorkOrder with agent_run, workspace/source paths, task identity, and expected result contract
boundaries.output_result: Agent result with work_order_id, workspace_id, launch_id, result_id, verification_id, status, evidence_refs
boundaries.state_transition: task admitted → agent-host dispatch → worker execution lifecycle

boundaries.transport_or_signal: DNA_OS_AGENT_INPUT_V1 to a controlled worker process
boundaries.endpoint: Worker process launch; no external network endpoint
boundaries.authentication: Agent Host launch boundary and environment allowlist; credential values are not passed/recorded
boundaries.authority_permission: Worker kind=LOCAL; allowed operations and paths come from the WorkOrder/WorkspaceManager, not the model
boundaries.input_schema: DNA_OS_AGENT_INPUT_V1 with work_order_id, workspace_id, objective, source_refs, allowed_operations, allowed_write_paths, expected_result_contract=DNA_OS_AGENT_RESULT_V1
boundaries.output_result: Launch record with launch_id, exit code, stdout/stderr, timing, and worker status

boundaries.transport_or_signal: Workspace lifecycle events and assigned write path
boundaries.endpoint: Local filesystem worktree path resolved from the reservation; not guessed by the worker
boundaries.authority_permission: Allowed read/write scope is assigned before worker execution; worker cannot choose the source path
boundaries.output_result: Workspace state and isolated worktree path
boundaries.state_transition: CREATE → PREPARE_CONTEXT → ASSIGN_AGENT(LOCAL) → RUNNING → RESULT_RECEIVED → VERIFYING → ACCEPTED → CLOSED

boundaries.transport_or_signal: DNA_OS_AGENT_RESULT_V1, verification evidence, task/workspace lifecycle events
boundaries.endpoint: Local append-only JSONL evidence/task stores and joint monitor
boundaries.authentication: Result is correlated to task_id/work_order_id/launch_id; verification must pass before acceptance
boundaries.authority_permission: Only verified result status can transition the workspace/task to ACCEPTED/COMPLETED
boundaries.input_schema: Worker exit/result contract plus evidence references
boundaries.output_result: result_id=result-995507d6-5414-4897-8831-8e5db34d9a35, verification status PASS, evidence references, terminal decision
boundaries.state_transition: LAUNCHED → VERIFYING → ACCEPTED → CLOSED; owner task COMPLETED

boundaries.endpoint: Response on the same MCP HTTP/stdio transport
boundaries.authentication: No new authority is created on return; correlation and DNA OS identifiers are preserved
boundaries.authority_permission: The MCP layer reports Core's actual outcome; it does not decide success or fabricate evidence
boundaries.output_result: MCP result containing command_id, work_id, task_id, result status, output lane, dispatcher task id, evidence, error, reason_code, raw Core body
boundaries.state_transition: DNA OS terminal state is returned to the external model/tool
failure_modes: missing result/evidence fields surfaced as null/empty

execution_run_boundary.statement: execution.run from live POST /owner/submit-command is not verified/wired in this connection because executionRequestBase is not supplied by the live HTTP ingress. The router's runExecutionStep explicitly blocks when executionPolicyContext or executionRequestBase is missing; this document does not claim execution.run execution.
execution_run_boundary.evidence_reference: No live execution.run success evidence is claimed.

voice_bridge.distinction: Previously verified voice-bridge COMPLETED path is an in-process capability result; the agent-host path documented here is worker dispatch through runAgentWorkOrder, LOCAL process launch, isolation, and result verification.

projections.developer_view: This JSON document's canonical_path, source_code_reference, schemas, endpoints, and failure_modes; human projection links back here

future_document_rule: A future connection document must use this same single semantic-record pattern: one stable document_id, explicit nodes and every cross-module boundary, per-boundary contract/transport/auth/authority/schema/result/state/source/evidence/failure/status fields, secret references without values, and human/developer projections pointing to the machine record. Do not create a second independent narrative record.
